metadata.title: The Friday Brief Isn't Outside News.
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: what does Claude's 'Friday brief' actually check — outside market news, or something else? Lands the carry-out that the brief is your own revenue vs the prior week, top sellers, wins and watches, run through a seven or fourteen day window you pick.
metadata.anchor_pair: N/A — source is skill-teardown format (anatomy -> pipeline -> constraint -> verdict), no anchor structure to preserve

beats.narration_text: Someone assumes a Friday brief means outside market news, delivered each week. It doesn't. It's your own numbers — revenue against last week, top sellers, wins and watches, over the past seven or fourteen days.

shot.new_visual_element: Writer types 'Can Claude send me Friday news every week?', hesitates on 'news', corrects to 'numbers'

props.text:

beats.note: B00 is Remotion (BrutalistHesitantWriter) per hai-simple SKILL.md WRITER LAW. TIMING LAW: 20-35 word narration + lead_silence_s 0.8 to give the typing a >=9s window; verify media/B00.mp4 >= 8s and that the correction ('news' -> 'numbers') is visible on a late frame.

beats.act: 1 anatomy — a skill is a folder
beats.narration_text: This kind of brief is built from something called a skill — a folder Claude reads before it works. Inside is one file, written in plain language, that spells out exactly what this weekly check covers. Claude reads the file, then follows it. The file is the whole program.

shot.new_visual_element: A folder icon opening to reveal SKILL.md, references/, scripts/; SKILL.md highlighted

production_viz.label: A skill is a folder
production_viz.mechanic: A folder opens on cream to reveal three items: SKILL.md (highlighted in crimson), a references/ folder, a scripts/ folder. A caption below reads 'Claude reads it, then follows it.'

beats.narration_text: The steps run in order: read the file, work through each step exactly as written, then return the result. Nothing runs out of sequence unless a step itself says so.

shot.new_visual_element: Three-phase pipeline: Read SKILL.md -> Execute steps in order -> Return result

production_viz.label: Input in, output out
production_viz.mechanic: Three cards left to right joined by arrows: 'Read SKILL.md', 'Execute steps in order', 'Return result'. Linear, no branch points drawn.

beats.narration_text: For this skill, the pulse covers exactly four things: revenue measured against the week before, top sellers, wins, and watches — items worth keeping an eye on. The lookback window can widen from seven days to fourteen, but that's the only knob. Ask it about anything outside those four things and there's no mode that covers it.

shot.new_visual_element: Four field cards: revenue vs prior week, top sellers, wins, watches; a boundary line with 'nothing outside this list' beyond it

production_viz.label: Exactly four fields
production_viz.mechanic: Four rows fill in one at a time with a checkmark: 'Revenue — vs. the week before', 'Top sellers', 'Wins', 'Watches — worth keeping an eye on'. A dashed boundary line beneath the list, with a faint unlabelled field beyond it captioned 'nothing outside this list'.

beats.narration_text: The Friday brief isn't outside market news — it's your own numbers: revenue against last week, top sellers, wins and watches, run over whichever window you pick, seven days or fourteen.

props.sparkLine: Your own numbers, not outside news.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Here's the prompt — read it with me. Ask Claude: look at my sales from the past week, compare revenue to the week before, tell me my top sellers, and call out anything that counts as a win or something worth watching. If I want a longer view, run it over the last fourteen days instead of seven. Liam, in for Bear.
